title: Escaping to a Snowy World
en: so so we have been blessed with an early

snowfall this season while it is uncertain how long it will stay its message is clear the snowflakes whisper of a winter yet to come and the animals take note and seek to fill their bellies while there is still plants and meat in abundance have you ever heard of the white stag it is a symbol that appears in many ancient legends and is often associated with the pursuit of wisdom

spiritual fulfillment and consequently freedom i've always connected the stag to the first snowfall i imagine it as a harbinger of winter as a child i remember peeping through the frosted aspen groves looking for those pearly antlers and noble white muzzle certain legends portray the stag as running from those who are seeking truth it does not easily let itself be caught only those who are patient thoughtful gentle yet courageous are ever privy to the magic as a lover of legends and folklore i've recently felt the need to re-read my favorite fairy tales and myths and connect with the stories that once entranced and astounded my ancestors there is something about the first snow

that makes me want to go within and to spend some time reflecting on the year seeing it for what it is full of both good and difficult moments but also a time that has become part of my personal history and a collection of feelings and events that i can learn from and may yet make into my own legends and stories that will be passed on to those i love that being said i have no more words to describe the beauty of what surrounds me this day so i will let nature tell you in her own
zh: 所以我们很幸运能够早日
这个季节下雪，但不确定会持续多久，它的信息很明确，雪花低语着冬天即将到来，动物们注意到并在植物和肉类仍然丰富的情况下寻求填饱肚子你听说过白色雄鹿吗？它是一个出现在许多古代传说中的象征，通常与追求智慧联系在一起

精神上的满足和随之而来的自由 我总是将雄鹿与第一场降雪联系起来 我想象它是冬天的预兆 我还是个孩子 我记得在结霜的白杨树林中窥视寻找那些珍珠般的鹿角和高贵的白色枪口 某些传说将雄鹿描绘成逃离那些寻求真理的人 它不会轻易让自己被抓住 只有那些耐心、深思熟虑、温柔而勇敢的人 作为传说和民间传说的爱好者，永远了解魔法我最近觉得有必要重读我最喜欢的童话故事和神话，并与那些曾经让我的祖先着迷和震惊的故事联系起来，第一场雪有一些东西
这让我想要深入内心，花一些时间反思这一年，看看这一年充满了美好和困难的时刻，但也成为我个人历史的一部分，也是我可以从中学习的一系列感受和事件的时刻，这些感觉和事件将成为我自己的传奇和故事，这些传奇和故事将传递给我所爱的人，话虽如此，我没有更多的言语来描述今天周围的美丽，所以我会让大自然用她自己的方式告诉你
